name: web-team-section-on-curved-dashed-path
title: Meet-the-team section with duotone portraits on a diagonal dashed path
whatItIs: A periwinkle-to-white vertical gradient with a small title 'Meet the Team' at the top. Three circular duotone portraits with names and roles step diagonally down to the left along a dotted curved path.
whatItMeans: Airy, friendly and guided; the path invites the eye through the team like a journey.
techniques: Place portraits along a dashed curved line instead of a grid.
Tint portraits in the brand blue for cohesion.
Give each portrait a soft circular halo and shadow.
Keep type minimal in two tones (dark and grey).
bestFor: Any section wanting an organic flow

vocabulary.definition: A photo tinted with brand colours.
A soft circle around an avatar.
Arranging items in a stepped diagonal.
